name: spec-review
description: A spec, plan or technical-requirements document judged against its PRD, seed and framework docs. The measured panel: it reproduces the four lenses of the 2026-06-26 annotate full-spec round, one seat per model family. No Claude seat by default: the host session that authors and reconciles is a Claude model, so a Claude reviewer is the seat most correlated with the artifact.

optional_seats.note: A fifth family is seated here when the artifact is large enough to earn it. `deepseek` because the four seated families are openai, glm, kimi and xai, and it is the one remaining non-Claude family the config carries at all three tiers — promoting this seat onto a family already at the table would seat two lenses on one mind and inflate every agreement count it touches. Off by default because the measured panel is the four-lens one and a fifth seat changes what those counts mean; the completeness persona exists now, so moving this into `seats` is a one-line edit.
